fusions.name: Bigger They Stand
fusions.desc: A headlong butt that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every tenth of its health the target still has (max 25%).

fusions.name: Clear the Ledge
fusions.desc: A spin with lowered horns that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Four Points Planted
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 control conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Mountain-Bred Balance

riders.text: a blow has to find you on the ledge first
and a slope is as good as a road
and what does land finds you braced

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your dodge chance rises by 4%, from silver you move 5% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 6%.
